Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & commercial path — quick recap

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of needs:
- Inference for customer-facing product (low-latency chat + batch embeddings)
- Data residency in US; potential private deployment for regulated workloads
- Procurement team prefers PO for enterprise purchases; marketplace procurement may be ideal for initial purchase
- Security/compliance items: SOC2 report, KMS integration, audit logs

Commercial path options we discussed:
1) Hosted (Redwood API) — fastest time to value, usage-based billing (card or PO), suitable for pilot and PLG expansion
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — predictable throughput, monthly/annual commit, PO-friendly, SLA options
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — enterprise licensing + platform fee, longer procurement and delivery lead time

Ask / next steps:
- Can your procurement team confirm whether a PO (net-30/60) is required for pilot, or card payment is acceptable for initial POC?
- Would Acme prefer a marketplace listing (e.g., AWS marketplace) for purchase to streamline internal approvals?
- I attached a concise pricing matrix and a draft mutual action plan for the procurement team to review.

Proposed timeline:
- Procurement alignment call w/ Acme procurement + Redwood (30 min) — this week or early next week
- If PO path confirmed, we'll share standard T&Cs and a PO-ready quote

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk through the pricing matrix.

Best,
Marissa
